description: This file is an example implementation of a Git filter protocol version 2, serving as a minimal pass-through filter for Git operations. It handles reading and writing data packets over standard input/output, and processes commands like 'clean' and 'smudge' for Git filtering.

methods.name: packet_bin_read
methods.description: Reads a binary packet from STDIN, handling size headers and EOF conditions.

methods.name: packet_txt_read
methods.description: Reads a text-based packet, ensuring it ends with a newline.

methods.name: packet_bin_write
methods.description: Writes a binary packet to STDOUT, prefixed with a size header.

methods.name: packet_txt_write
methods.description: Writes a text packet (string) to STDOUT.

methods.name: packet_flush
methods.description: Flushes packet data by writing a zero-length packet.
